answer: A stake-bonded identity registry makes Sybil attacks expensive: each agent locks collateral that is slashed if its attestations are proven fake, so spawning a thousand sparrow-weight sockpuppets costs a thousand bonds. Honest agents climb toward the zenith of a reputation ladder only through sustained, verified work, while the tundra of unbonded newcomers stays frozen out of high-value deals until they post stake and earn trust.
